To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a model that captures the dynamics of a distributed power transmission network and that can be solved efficiently using a novel algorithm.
the centralized optimal solution for the power network model can be constructed by generalizing recent methods for the centralized optimal solution of a demand-driven production system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimal design of power systems to ensure reliability.
the design and analysis of optimal reserve policies for power networks.
the design of reliable power systems, which is an essential component of a reliable electric power system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the model developed here provides an effective tool to analyze the optimal reserve procurement problem in a large-scale power transmission network, and to evaluate the effect of various factors on the optimal solution.
the proposed approach provides the system operator with a tool for evaluating the impact of various reserve procurement policies on the overall reliability of the power network.
the model and solution approach are useful for the design of reliable transmission networks, and for evaluating the impact of new generation sources on reliability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach can be applied to a large-scale power transmission system to provide a centralized optimal reserve capacity plan.
we show how to construct an optimal solution for a distributed power transmission network model.
the optimal solution to the power network control problem can be computed in a centralized manner by solving a convex program.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a centralized optimal control policy is a useful tool for the system operator to evaluate the performance of the current network and the impact of future changes to the system.
, in the absence of transmission constraints, a system operator can optimally procure reserves by considering the variability in demand and the ramping constraints on generators.
the optimal reserve allocation problem can be solved efficiently using a mixed-integer linear programming approach.
